            <milestone n="c. 'bre'" unit="section"/>
            yang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">'bre </rs> <expan>sogs</expan> na re dran pa bcad shes yin te sngar tshogs laM du rigs shes kyis rtogs zin <note type="gloss">pa</note> la 'jug pa'i <expan>phyir ro</expan> zhes gsung pa ni ma yin te | 'di ltar rtogs zin la 'jug pa'i cha yod de mnyaM bzhag ma yin la | mnyaM bzhag la tshogs lam bcad shes ma yin pa'i <expan>phyir ro</expan> || 

            <milestone n="c. bzad pa" unit="section"/>
            yang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4307">kha cig</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4307">bzad pa</rs></note> na re blo rig bdun <pb n="52b"/> <lb n="52b1"/> du ma 'dus so gsung pa ni mi rigs te | rjes su mthun la phyin ci log |ces pa'i phyir ro || </seg></TEI>
